shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions escalate as renewed US-Iran strikes fuel global risk-off sentiment.
Bitcoin holds above $62K despite market's Extreme Fear (index at 22-23); ETF inflows offer modest support.
US Crypto Clarity Act expected in Senate, aiming for clearer digital asset regulations.
Hawkish Fed outlook persists with higher-for-longer rates due to inflation concerns.
Ethereum spot ETF launch anticipated by July 15, but a technical death cross recently formed.
